scope.writer: Only conv_0..conv_9/session/native of fresh original session Writer.
scope.source: Fresh retrieval plus all JEV phase ledgers, retaining original R03 402 firstpass separately from recovery.
scope.qa: Fresh firstpass plus terminal zero-job technical recovery.
scope.limits: Ledger-only accounting. No raw response/cache-body verification, full scientific replay, metrics, old Gemini 3.8 artifacts, credentials, API or pricing lookups. QA large manifests and raw seal are not required or rebound in this narrow report.

definitions.physical_attempt: Each non-cache ledger row, including all failed HTTP and transport attempts, counted once without deduplication across namespaces.
definitions.local_cache_event: Only ledger-recorded cache_hit=true events; copied usage is excluded from physical sums. Failed logical same-hash reuse is not inferred as a ledger cache event: retained original R03 firstpass has zero cache_hit=true rows.
definitions.provider_cached_input_tokens: Explicit cachedContentTokenCount on physical Gemini responses; subset of prompt tokens and never added to them. Absent fields are unavailable, not zero.
definitions.thinking_tokens: Explicit thoughtsTokenCount only. The field is absent throughout, so reported total is null; configured thinkingBudget=0 is not substituted as a usage measurement.
definitions.sum_reported: Partial sum of numeric values on physical rows; null if no numeric value exists. Missing/error usage is not treated as zero.
definitions.complete_total: Only numeric when all applicable physical attempts report the field; otherwise null.
definitions.embedding_usage: Embedding/countTokens usage is not recorded in these ledgers. Numeric token totals remain unavailable.
definitions.cost: No verified tariff or invoice applied; cost remains unknown.
definitions.qa_arm_attribution: Physical usage grouped by producer arm is not marginal arm cost because identical requests share responses.

seal_algorithm: SHA256 canonical UTF8 JSON, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon), excluding content_sha256
